_comment: Orchestra-managed Codex hooks file. CodexAdapter.prepareToLaunch renders this (replacing __ORCHESTRA_BIN__ with the live `orchestra` binary path and __AGENT_ID__ with the agent id) into dataDir/codex-hooks.json, then installs it into the pinned $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json (only when absent or already Orchestra's — never clobbering a foreign user hooks.json). Codex's SessionStart hook (Claude-parity) reads `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` from stdout; the `session` event yields the card's column/mode/self-id orientation. Orientation ONLY — Codex telemetry stays the daemon-side rollout tail (its adapter.parse returns nil for this push), so this hook sends no StatusReport.
